the interaction of two properties of neuronal dynamics, short-term synaptic depression and firing adaptation, and their implications for the operating mode of the neuron.
understanding the role of synaptic plasticity, in particular short-term depression, and firing dynamics, in determining the operating mode of neurons.

the interaction between the pre- and postsynaptic dynamics determines the operating mode of the neuron.

the interaction between the pre- and postsynaptic properties of a neuron can be used as a mechanism for shaping the input–output transformation.
